---
title: "Env.GetBool"
description: "Get a bool value (as 0/1) by key from the Env store."
---

Get the `bool` value associated with `key`, returned as `0` or `1`. Returns `0` if the key is absent or if the key holds a different kind.

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native int GetBool(string key);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| key | `string` | The key to read. |

## Returns

`1` if the stored bool was non-zero, `0` otherwise. Also `0` if the key is absent or holds a non-Bool kind.

## Behavior

The kind check is strict. A key whose value was written via [Env.SetInt](./setint) returns `0` here even if the underlying int was `1`: Bool is its own kind, separate from Int, even though both surface as `int` in script.

## Edge cases

- Missing keys return `0`.
- A `key` whose value was set by [Env.SetInt](./setint) returns `0` regardless of the stored value.
- A `key` whose value was set by [Env.SetString](./setstring) returns `0`.

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetBool("enabled", 1);
if (Env.GetBool("enabled")) { Console.Log("on"); }
```
